claim: The optional v3.0 evidence-ledger column that records the SPDX license identifier of the source is license_spdx
sub_question: Which optional v3.0 column records the SPDX license identifier?
evidence: Provenance/compliance v3.0 section lists license_spdx for declared license of the captured source (SPDX-style token, NOASSERTION, or LicenseRef-...).
quote_or_anchor: | `license_spdx` | empty, `NOASSERTION`, an SPDX-style token (`MIT`, `Apache-2.0`, `CC-BY-4.0`, `CC-BY-NC-4.0`, ...), or `LicenseRef-<token>` | Declared license of the captured source.
notes: Cross-checked with CHANGELOG.md v3.0 note naming license_spdx among the three optional columns.
